description.value: Brookside Motel is a cabin-style property in Golden, BC, offering individual self-contained units with full kitchens, mountain views, and air conditioning. Golden sits at the gateway to six national parks—including Yoho, Banff, and Kootenay—and is home to Kicking Horse Mountain Resort, a notable summer mountain-biking destination. Fast-food, gas stations, and restaurants are within walking distance, making it a practical stopover for touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley.
